audit_coverage.finding: Catalog and signed V53 evidence contain 14 Providers; the legacy completeness matrix contains 13 and omits time-check. This matrix uses the catalog as enumeration truth and records the missing dedicated time-check audit as a gap.

architecture_contract.classification_scope: One decision per catalog Provider for its dominant mechanical chart layer. Shared calendar normalization does not change a self-owned Provider into WRAP.
architecture_contract.public_contract_rule: Runtime Canonical Facts are the only external fact truth. Third-party raw objects or JSON remain private behind the Engine Adapter and must never become Backend, Web, LLM, evidence or snapshot contracts.
architecture_contract.normalizer_rule: Timezone, coordinates, true-solar-time, Zi-hour, leap-month, epoch, school and horizon policies remain owned and versioned before or around the engine boundary.

classification_definitions.KEEP: A licensed, pinned engine is already isolated behind a stable internal service; retain it and do not rewrite merely for uniformity.
classification_definitions.WRAP: The current licensed engine remains the default, but direct/raw coupling or an incomplete per-art Canonical Facts seam requires an explicit Engine Adapter.
classification_definitions.REPLACE-CANDIDATE: A current self-owned mechanical layer has a licensed frozen comparator broad enough for a controlled differential trial; this is not approval to adopt or replace.
classification_definitions.SELF-OWNED: No qualified mature OSS engine covers the selected convention, or the capability is observation/policy/composition rather than a standalone chart engine.
